Bootstrap a Debian root filesystem with mmdebstrap.

## Inputs

No artifact inputs.

## Parameters

<dl class="reference-list">

<dt>

`suite`

</dt>
<dd>

Default: `"stable"`

Debian suite or codename, such as bookworm or trixie.

</dd>

<dt>

`snapshot`

</dt>
<dd>

Default: `""`

Debian snapshot timestamp. Empty uses the selected mirror instead.

</dd>

<dt>

`mirror`

</dt>
<dd>

Default: `""`

Custom Debian mirror URL. Empty uses mmdebstrap's default. A snapshot takes
precedence.

</dd>

<dt>

`components`

</dt>
<dd>

Default: `"main"`

Space-separated archive components for an explicit custom mirror.

</dd>

</dl>

## Scheduling

<dl class="reference-list">

<dt>

Priority

</dt>
<dd>

`10000000`

</dd>

<dt>

Dependencies

</dt>
<dd>

None

</dd>

</dl>

Higher priorities run first within the selected recipe set unless `before` or
`after` constraints require otherwise. Dependencies include other recipes
without ordering them.

## Behavior

Use this recipe in a root layer. A snapshot selects a dated Debian archive and
disables its validity-date check. A custom mirror is passed to mmdebstrap as a
trusted source. The components parameter applies to that custom mirror.

## Example

For example, add the recipe to a root layer (set `root = true` instead of a
parent):

```toml title="layers/base.toml"
root = true
recipes = ["core/debian-bootstrap"]

[parameters."core/debian-bootstrap"]
suite = "trixie"
```
